text.2:11: And when it is said unto them: Make not mischief in the earth, they say: We are peacemakers only.
text.2:27: Those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah ordered to be joined, and (who) make mischief in the earth: Those are they who are the losers.
text.2:30: And when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to place a viceroy in the earth, they said: Wilt thou place therein one who will do harm therein and will shed blood, while we, we hymn Thy praise and sanctify Thee? He said: Surely I know that which ye know not.
text.2:205: And when he turneth away (from thee) his effort in the land is to make mischief therein and to destroy the crops and the cattle; and Allah loveth not mischief.
text.7:56: Work not confusion in the earth after the fair ordering (thereof). and call on Him in fear and hope. Lo! the mercy of Allah is nigh unto the good.
text.7:85: And unto Midian (We sent) their brother, Shu'eyb. He said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Lo! a clear proof hath come unto you from your Lord; so give full measure and full weight and wrong not mankind in their goods, and work not confusion in the earth after the fair ordering thereof. That will be better for you, if ye are believers.
text.7:127: The chiefs of Pharaoh's people said: (O King), wilt thou suffer Moses and his people to make mischief in the land, and flout thee and thy gods? He said: We will slay their sons and spare their women, for lo! we are in power over them.
text.12:73: They said: By Allah, well ye know we came not to do evil in the land, and are no thieves.
text.13:25: And those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah hath commanded should be joined, and make mischief in the earth: theirs is the curse and theirs the ill abode.
text.16:88: For those who disbelieve and debar (men) from the way of Allah, We add doom to doom because they wrought corruption,
text.17:4: And We decreed for the Children of Israel in the Scripture: Ye verily will work corruption in the earth twice, and ye will become great tyrants.
text.26:152: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not.
text.27:34: She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame. Thus will they do.
text.27:48: And there were in the city nine persons who made mischief in the land and reformed not.
text.47:22: Would ye then, if ye were given the command, work corruption in the land and sever your ties of kinship?
